videos.title: Beep Beep, Here We Go! | Cars and Trucks Song for Kids with Real Vehicle Sounds
videos.hook: A brand-new sing-along song about cars and trucks: the ice cream truck, a tow truck, a delivery truck, diggers, the car wash, the garbage truck and the school bus, with the real noises they make.
videos.learn: Sing the chorus, copy the noises (beep beep, honk honk, vroom vroom), and learn road safety: red means stop, green means go, wait for the school bus stop arm, slow down for speed bumps.

song.title: Beep Beep, Here We Go!
chorus: red means stop and green means go,

scenes.caption: The ice cream truck
scenes.ask: What does the ice cream truck say?
verse: The ice cream truck comes down the street,
it plays a lit-tle tune so sweet,
we stand in line and wait our turn,
so ma-ny fla-vors we can learn!

scenes.caption: The tow truck helps
scenes.ask: What does the tow truck say when it backs up?
verse: Oh no, the lit-tle car won't go,
call the tow truck, nice and slow,
it backs up close and lifts it high,
off to the gar-age, wave good-bye!

scenes.caption: The delivery truck
scenes.ask: What does the de-liv-ery truck say?
verse: The de-liv-ery truck has box-es to bring,
a big brown box, a ti-ny thing,
it stops at ev-ery house in town,
and puts each par-cel gent-ly down.

scenes.caption: A night drive on the highway
scenes.ask: What does the en-gine say?
verse: The moon is up, the stars are bright,
our head-lights shine to light the night,
we keep a gap be-hind the truck,
our seat belts on, all safe and snug!

scenes.caption: Slow down for speed bumps
scenes.ask: What does the lit-tle car say?
verse: Here comes a bump up on the street,
slow down, slow down, so nice and neat,
bump-e-ty bump, we roll a-long,
count the bumps and sing our song!

scenes.caption: Diggers and dump trucks
scenes.ask: What does the big dump truck say?
verse: The dig-ger digs a ve-ry big hole,
the dump truck tips its load of soil,
the flag-ger holds the sign up high,
we wait, then slow-ly we go by.

scenes.caption: Time for a car wash
scenes.ask: What does the wa-ter say?
verse: Our car is mud-dy, what a mess,
in-to the car wash, yes yes yes!
the brush-es spin, the bub-bles flow,
now it's shi-ny, see it glow!

scenes.caption: Garbage day in the rain
scenes.ask: What does the gar-bage truck say?
verse: The gar-bage truck comes rain or shine,
it picks the bins up one at a time,
the big arm lifts and tips them in,
then puts back ev-ery emp-ty bin.

scenes.caption: The car carrier truck
scenes.ask: What does the big truck say?
verse: A long truck car-ries cars to town,
some go up and some go down,
let's count the cars, one two three four,
five and six, and then no more!

scenes.caption: The school bus takes us home
scenes.ask: What does the school bus say?
verse: The yel-low school bus takes us home,
through the town and o-ver the hill,
when the red stop arm swings out,
all the cars wait, then stay so still!

videos.title: Toot Toot, Off We Float! | Boats Song for Kids with Real Boat Sounds
videos.hook: A brand-new sing-along song about boats: a little tugboat, a fireboat water show, a lighthouse in the fog, dolphins, a busy port, kayaks, a speedboat, a ferry and a paddle steamer, with the real sounds they make.
videos.learn: Sing the chorus, copy the noises (toot toot, splish splash, vroom vroom), count the containers, learn red and green buoys, and see that everyone on a boat wears a life jacket.

song.title: Toot Toot, Off We Float!
chorus: on the wa-ter in a boat,
life jack-ets on, we're safe and sound,
waves go up and waves go down!

scenes.caption: The little tugboat
scenes.ask: What does the tug-boat say?
verse: The lit-tle tug is small but strong,
it push-es big ships right a-long,
it nudg-es gent-ly side to side,
un-til the ship is safe and tied!

scenes.caption: The fireboat's water show
scenes.ask: What does the fire-boat say?
verse: The fire-boat sprays a wa-ter show,
big white foun-tains, high and low,
a rain-bow shines in-side the spray,
hoo-ray, hoo-ray, a hap-py day!

scenes.caption: The lighthouse in the fog
scenes.ask: What does the big ship say?
verse: The fog is thick, it's hard to see,
the light-house shines for you and me,
the big ship blows its fog-horn loud,
to find its way right through the cloud.

scenes.caption: Dolphins at sunset
scenes.ask: What do the dol-phins say?
verse: The sail-boat glides a-cross the sea,
the dol-phins jump, one, two, three!
they leap and dive and swim a-round,
and splash back in with a hap-py sound!

scenes.caption: The busy port
scenes.ask: What does the big ship say?
verse: The ship is full of box-es bright,
red and blue and green and white,
the crane lifts each one up and down,
to send them off to ev-ery town.

scenes.caption: Paddling down the river
scenes.ask: What do the pad-dles say?
verse: We pad-dle, pad-dle down the stream,
the ri-ver spar-kles, what a dream,
left side, right side, nice and slow,
down the ri-ver, here we go!

scenes.caption: Speedboat and buoys
scenes.ask: What does the speed-boat say?
verse: The speed-boat zips a-cross the bay,
the buoys show the safe-est way,
red on one side, green on the oth-er,
stay be-tween them, sis-ter, bro-ther!

scenes.caption: All aboard the car ferry
scenes.ask: What does the fer-ry say?
verse: The fer-ry o-pens up its door,
the cars drive on, then one car more,
it car-ries them a-cross the bay,
then off they drive, a-way, a-way!

scenes.caption: The paddle steamer
scenes.ask: What does the steam-boat say?
verse: The pad-dle wheel goes round and round,
it churns the wa-ter, what a sound,
the steam puffs up in-to the sky,
we wave to boats as they go by.

scenes.caption: A sailing race at sunset
scenes.ask: What does the start horn say?
verse: The sail-boats race out in the breeze,
their sails puff up, they move with ease,
blue and red and yel-low too,
which one wins? It's up to you!

videos.title: Zoom Zoom, Up So High! | Airplanes Song for Kids with Real Airplane Sounds
videos.hook: A brand-new sing-along song about airplanes: an air show with coloured smoke, small and big jets taking off, a glider, the airport helpers, a seaplane and flying above the clouds, with the real sounds they make.
videos.learn: Sing the chorus, copy the noises (zoom zoom, buzz buzz, splish splash), compare small, big and biggest planes, and learn about landing gear, gliders and contrails.

song.title: Zoom Zoom, Up So High!
chorus: wheels go up and wings spread wide,

scenes.caption: The air show
scenes.ask: What do the lit-tle planes say?
verse: Three lit-tle planes fly in a row,
they draw with smoke, a rain-bow show,
they loop and loop and turn a-round,
and wave their wings to the crowd on the ground!

scenes.caption: Small, big and biggest
scenes.ask: What does the big jet say?
verse: A lit-tle plane goes first to fly,
a big jet next goes up so high,
the big-gest jet takes off the last,
small, big, big-gest, zoom-ing past!

scenes.caption: The glider has no engine
scenes.ask: What does the tow plane say?
verse: A glid-er has no en-gine, see,
a tow plane pulls it high and free,
the rope lets go, it floats a-long,
it rides the wind and hums a song.

scenes.caption: Airport helpers
scenes.ask: What does the lit-tle tug say?
verse: The bag-gage train brings bags in line,
the fuel truck fills the plane up fine,
the mar-shal waves the sticks just so,
to tell the pi-lot where to go.

scenes.caption: Pushback and taxi
scenes.ask: What do the jet en-gines say?
verse: A lit-tle tug can push a plane,
it backs it out a-long the lane,
then on the ta-xi-way we roll,
to-ward the run-way, that's our goal!

scenes.caption: Take off at sunset
scenes.ask: What does the air-plane say?
verse: Fas-ter, fas-ter, down the strip,
the nose goes up, it's time to lift,
the land-ing gear folds up in-side,
up, up, up, we take a ride!

scenes.caption: Up through the clouds
scenes.ask: What does the jet say up high?
verse: In-to the clouds so soft and white,
it's fog-gy now, then sun-shine bright,
we climb a-bove them, way up high,
a sea of clouds be-neath the sky!

scenes.caption: The seaplane lands on the lake
scenes.ask: What does the wa-ter say?
verse: A plane with floats in-stead of wheels,
it lands on wa-ter, what fun it feels!
it skims and splash-es on the lake,
and leaves a big white foam-y wake.

scenes.caption: Flying over the farm
scenes.ask: What does the lit-tle plane say?
verse: We fly a-bove the farm so green,
the cows and sheep and barn are seen,
the fields are gold be-neath the sun,
what a love-ly flight, what fun!

scenes.caption: Above the clouds at sunset
scenes.ask: What does the jum-bo jet say?
verse: Way up high a-bove the clouds,
far a-way from all the crowds,
jet planes draw long lines of white,
they're called con-trails, what a sight!

videos.title: Choo Choo, Clickety-Clack! | Trains Song for Kids with Real Train Sounds
videos.hook: A brand-new sing-along song about trains: a city tram, two trains passing, a steam train drinking at the water tower, a bullet train, a freight train to count, a level crossing and a mountain tunnel, with the real sounds they make.
videos.learn: Sing the chorus, copy the noises (choo choo, ding ding, honk honk), count the freight cars to ten, and learn train safety: stand behind the yellow line and wait at the crossing gates.

song.title: Choo Choo, Clickety-Clack!
chorus: trains are roll-ing down the track,

scenes.caption: The city tram
scenes.ask: What does the tram bell say?
verse: The tram rolls through the ci-ty street,
on shi-ny rails so clean and neat,
it stops to let the peo-ple on,
ding ding, and then the tram is gone!

scenes.caption: Two trains passing
scenes.ask: What does the train horn say?
verse: Two trains are com-ing, can you see?
one for you and one for me,
they pass each oth-er side by side,
on their own tracks, safe and wide!

scenes.caption: The steam train gets a drink
scenes.ask: What does the steam train say?
verse: The steam train's thirs-ty, time to stop,
the wa-ter tow-er fills it to the top,
the wa-ter makes the steam, you know,
and steam makes all the wheels go!

scenes.caption: Steam train at sunset
scenes.ask: What do the steam puffs say?
verse: The old steam train puffs up the hill,
the rods go round, they're nev-er still,
puff puff puff, the smoke goes high,
a big grey cloud up in the sky!

scenes.caption: The super fast train
scenes.ask: What does the fast train say?
verse: The bul-let train is long and sleek,
it zooms a-long, so fast, so neat,
the wires a-bove give it pow-er,
lots of miles in just one hour!

scenes.caption: Count the freight cars
scenes.ask: What does the freight train say?
verse: The freight train is so ve-ry long,
let's count the cars and sing a song,
one two three four five six se-ven,
eight nine ten, they roll a-long!

scenes.caption: At the station
scenes.ask: What does the sta-tion bell say?
verse: The train slows down, the sta-tion's near,
the doors slide o-pen, we all cheer,
stand back be-hind the yel-low line,
all a-board, we're right on time!

scenes.caption: The level crossing
scenes.ask: What does the train horn say?
verse: Ding ding, the cross-ing gates come down,
the cars all stop in our small town,
the train rolls by, we wait and see,
then up go the gates for you and me!

scenes.caption: Through the mountain tunnel
scenes.ask: What does the train say in the tun-nel?
verse: The train goes in-to the moun-tain tall,
through a tun-nel, dark and small,
the lamps are on so we can see,
and out we come, as bright as can be!

scenes.caption: Over the river bridge
scenes.ask: What does the train say on the bridge?
verse: A big red bridge a-cross the stream,
the train rolls o-ver like a dream,
the boats be-low all toot hel-lo,
the train says choo choo, off we go!
